name: mou-mng-system
description: Centralised web platform for onboarding companies, capturing MOU commercial terms, and configuring scheme-wise trainee payroll across zones and plants.

scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@mou/domain && npm run build --workspace=@mou/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@mou/domain && npm run build --workspace=@mou/web
scripts.start:api: node src/api/dist/db/migrate.js && node src/api/dist/db/seed/index.js && node src/api/dist/index.js
